request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBTRN02C-003: Reject a transaction that would take the account over its credit limit

### given[0]: The account record was found for the cross-referenced account ID.
fields=['ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   391            END-READ
   392            EXIT.
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
>> 396               INVALID KEY
>> 397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
>> 399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT

### given[1]: The projected balance is current-cycle credit minus current-cycle debit plus the daily transaction amount.
fields=['WS-TEMP-BAL', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT', 'DALYTRAN-AMT'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
   406 
   407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
   408                   CONTINUE
   409                 ELSE

### given[2]: The projected balance is stored in a signed field with 9 integer digits and 2 decimals. The account cycle fields have 10 integer digits, so a result of 1,000,000,000 or more loses its high-order digit when stored (there is no ROUNDED or ON SIZE ERROR).
fields=['WS-TEMP-BAL', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   183 
   184         01 WS-COUNTERS.
   185            05 WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT          PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   186            05 WS-REJECT-COUNT               PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
>> 187            05 WS-TEMP-BAL                   PIC S9(09)V99.
   188 
   189         01 WS-FLAGS.
   190            05 WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC         PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
   191 
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.
    10            05  ACCT-OPEN-DATE                    PIC X(10).
    11            05  ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE               PIC X(10).
    12            05  ACCT-REISSUE-DATE                 PIC X(10).
>>  13            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT              PIC S9(10)V99.
>>  14            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT               PIC S9(10)V99.
    15            05  ACCT-ADDR-ZIP                     PIC X(10).
    16            05  ACCT-GROUP-ID                     PIC X(10).
    17            05  FILLER                            PIC X(178).
    18       *

### when[0]: The account credit limit is less than the stored projected balance. A balance exactly equal to the limit passes.
fields=['ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT', 'WS-TEMP-BAL'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
   406 
>> 407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
>> 408                   CONTINUE
>> 409                 ELSE
   410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
   412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   413                 END-IF

### then[0]: The failure reason is set to 102 and the description to 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['102', 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   406 
   407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
   408                   CONTINUE
   409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   413                 END-IF
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"The READ of ACCOUNT-FILE has a NOT INVALID KEY branch, which is the record-found path the rule's logic sits in."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 403-405 compute WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT, exactly as stated."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":true,"reason":"WS-TEMP-BAL is declared PIC S9(09)V99 and the cycle fields are S9(10)V99, so standard COBOL truncation drops high-order digits of results of 1,000,000,000 or more when no ON SIZE ERROR is coded."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"The IF passes (CONTINUE) when ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL, so the ELSE fires only when the limit is less than the balance, and equality passes."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"The ELSE branch moves 102 to WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON and 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION' to WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC."}]}
